biography.value: Elder Gales are the first Air Elemental that actively protects allies rather than simply fighting. Eye of the Storm ensures the summoner and designated companions are never accidentally caught in Vortex Presence or thrown by Thunderstrike's pushback — a meaningful distinction at a tier where battlefield chaos becomes genuinely dangerous. A typical turn spends two actions on Thunderstrike against priority targets and a third on Storm Surge when a line of enemies presents itself, or repositioning to maintain Momentum Defense. Agil 8 means the Elder Gale acts before virtually everything it faces.

system.attacksNotes:
Thunderstrike [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 8 + Melee Combat 6), Reach: 15 ft.

  • Margin 1:: 12 damage (7 + 5 Str) + 4 lightning damage (Half DR); target pushed 15 feet.
  • Margin 2: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage; pushed 15 feet + Stunned until end of their next turn; no save.
  • Margin 3: 12 damage, DR halved (round up) + 4 lightning damage + Stunned; target also Deafened for 1 minute.

Storm Surge [Combat]: Ranged attack (Dex 4 + Ranged Combat 5), 60-foot line, 5 feet wide.

  • Margin 1:: 16 lightning damage (12 + 4 Dex).
  • Margin 2: 16 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned until end of their next turn.
  • Margin 3: 16 lightning damage, DR halved (round up) + Stunned + knocked Prone.
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Eye of the Storm: The Elder Gale designates up to 6 creatures within 30 feet as protected. Protected creatures are immune to Vortex Presence and cannot be pushed or knocked Prone by any of the Elder Gale's ### Attacks or abilities. Designation changes as a [Free] action. Vortex Presence: Creatures starting their turn within 30 feet make a Fortitude [Hard] save or are pulled 10 feet directly toward the Tempest. Flying creatures add 1 to both their save dice. Momentum Defense: While the Elder Gale has moved at least half its fly speed this turn, ### Attacks against it add 1 to both attack dice. Storm Body: Grapple attempts add 1 to both dice. If successfully grappled, the Elder Gale makes a Fortitude [Easy] save at the start of its turn to break free automatically. Resilient Defense (2/day): When the Elder Gale fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
